modified_workflow: 01 build: stage order and processing tools unchanged from the frozen 001 create_packet.py; the correction register and every release chapter are derived from the frozen records.json, and the controlled document register table iterates all N records (one real row per record), so output size is driven by the actual record count
02 validate: dynamic validator reads frozen expected.json and covers every record plus document-level controls (metadata/style/margin/footer/header checks run once, not repeated per record)
03 render: unchanged LibreOffice -> PDF -> 150 DPI PNG render; page count is decided by real layout

scale_metadata.render_scope: full document; all pages rendered at 150 DPI
preserved_parent_behaviour: all parent chapter headings and their order
correction register, metadata, revision history, workflow and retirement tables with the frozen public values
release margins (0.8 in), footer with page field, header band, title/heading/table-header styling and core properties
page breaks before Distribution and Training Workflow and Final Release Appendix
changed_parent_behaviour: the Controlled Document Register table now holds one real row per declared record instead of a fixed register, so table row count is driven by the actual record count
the register narrative reports the actual record count

measurement_scope: Scales the number of controlled document records that must go through the full frozen 001 pipeline: draft-material removal, correction register, controlled metadata, revision history, distribution and training workflow, obsolete-copy retirement checklist and final release appendix. Both the source DOCX working content and the final release packet scale with the record count. Page count is decided by real LibreOffice layout; no page count is forged here.
